sloka: सकृदेव कृतो रावः सरक्तः प्रेषितो घनैः ।महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः ।। ७.३२.२२ ॥
transliteration: sakṛdeva kṛto rāvaḥ saraktaḥ preṣito ghanaiḥ ।mahodaramahāpārśvadhūmrākṣaśukasāraṇaiḥ ।। 7.32.22 ॥

translations.english: A single bloody cry was emitted by the clouds as an omen, while Ravana was accompanied by Mahodara, Mahaparshva, Dhumraksha, Shuka, and Sarana.
